create_pixtral_model: create a PixtralForConditionalGeneration multimodal model for image-text inference with vLLM
build_vision_encoder: build a VisionTransformer with 2D rotary embeddings and convolutional patch extraction for image encoding
process_image_input: process image pixel inputs through the vision encoder and patch merger to produce multimodal embeddings
compute_image_tokens: compute the number of image tokens produced by the vision encoder given image width and height
merge_spatial_patches: merge spatial patches from the vision encoder output using PatchMerger with configurable spatial merge size
